title: mcp: the record data tools and the record resource serve a declared 5xx refusal's own sentence, where /data withholds it ('Internal server error')
body:
domain:server#6 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5p3T5YWhLjurajudnQ

## What is wrong

A bridge member that throws a coded 5xx with its own sentence, for example `Object.assign(new Error('The ledger is closing.'), { code: 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', status: 503 })`, gets two answers:

- MCP `query_records`, `aggregate_records`, `get_record`, `create_record`, `update_record`, `delete_record`, `delete_records`' selection read and the `objectstack://objects/{name}/records/{id}` resource answer `{ code: 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'The ledger is closing.', status: 503 }`. The producer's own sentence reaches the agent.
- `/api/v1/data` (`mapDataError`) answers `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` `Internal server error`. Every declared 5xx's prose is withheld unless the throw marks itself `refusal: true` (commit 0783d7b80, `declaredRefusalMessage`).

## Expected

These faces serve a declared 5xx the way `/data` does, through the door's own reader (`mapDataError` / `declaredRefusalMessage` from `@objectstack/types`), never a copy: code and status kept, sentence withheld unless `refusal: true`, and the thrown text logged once.

## Where to start

- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`: `dataDoorRefusalEnvelope` (#31273) and `thrownRefusalEnvelope`.
- PR #31324 pins today's answer as a CONTROL row, so the move will show as that row changing.

## Provenance

Out-of-scope finding (class a) in the #31273 dev report 6716035669 on PR #31324. Filed by the seat as its carrier.
